cues.en: The astronaut in a black shirt and blue gloves tends the green leafy plants in the station module.
The gray-haired astronaut pulls back from the growth chamber, then reaches in again to rearrange the green leafy plants.
The astronaut keeps handling the plants, then pulls away from the chamber.
They return to the chamber and resume tending the plants before stepping back again.
The astronaut secures the growth chamber panel, closing it after the plant work.
A red chili pepper appears on a black mat with a white label. The astronaut picks it up for the camera.
The astronaut lifts a camera and photographs the pepper on the board.
Crewmates gather as the black-shirted astronaut passes a small green plant to the green-shirted astronaut, who smiles while holding it.
The green-shirted astronaut holds the small green plant and smiles while the blue-shirted astronaut leans in to inspect it and the camera-holding crewmate films.
The blue-shirted astronaut bites the chili pepper and chews while the group watches.
